name: Silvaco Group, Inc.
summary: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design (TCAD) software, electronic design automation (EDA) software, and semiconductor intellectual property (SIP) solutions in the United States and internationally. The company's TCAD software are used in semiconductor industry to model and optimize manufacturing process and device performance. Its EDA software solution include spice modelling, and simulation, parasitic extraction and reduction, standard cell generation and optical proximity correction.
